# opnsense_kea_dhcpv4_reservation (Data Source)

Reads an existing Kea DHCPv4 reservation on OPNsense by UUID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID to look up.

### Read-Only

- `client_id` (String) Client-id.
- `description` (String) Description of the reservation.
- `hostname` (String) Reservation hostname.
- `hw_address` (String) Client MAC address.
- `ip_address` (String) Reserved IPv4 address.
- `subnet_id` (String) Parent DHCPv4 subnet UUID.
